description: Run SpectrophotometricColorCalibration (SPCC). Requires the image to have an astrometric solution (run_plate_solve adds one) and to be linear (not stretched). Narrowband mode (narrowband_mode true) calibrates each channel as a narrow band: give the real filter centre and width per channel (red_/green_/blue_wavelength_nm and _bandwidth_nm; PixInsight's defaults are 656.3 / 500.7 / 500.7 nm and 3 nm for every band, wrong for a 5 nm H-alpha filter). The white reference matters for star colour: use a solar-type reference such as "G2V Star"; the default "Average Spiral Galaxy" makes a galaxy neutral and tints stars.

blue_bandwidth_nm.description: Narrowband mode: bandwidth of the blue channel's filter in nm (PixInsight default 3)

blue_filter_name.description: Measured B filter curve name, as listed by find_filters

blue_wavelength_nm.description: Narrowband mode: centre wavelength of the blue channel's filter in nm (default 500.7)

green_bandwidth_nm.description: Narrowband mode: bandwidth of the green channel's filter in nm (PixInsight default 3)

green_filter_name.description: Measured G filter curve name, as listed by find_filters

green_wavelength_nm.description: Narrowband mode: centre wavelength of the green channel's filter in nm (default 500.7)

qe_name.description: Camera QE curve name (find_filters channel Q)

red_bandwidth_nm.description: Narrowband mode: bandwidth of the red channel's filter in nm (PixInsight default 3)

red_filter_name.description: Measured R filter curve name, as listed by find_filters. Set all three filters and qe_name together for a full calibration.

red_wavelength_nm.description: Narrowband mode: centre wavelength of the red channel's filter in nm (default 656.3)

view_id.description: View ID to calibrate (must be linear, must have a WCS/astrometric solution)

white_reference.description: White reference name from PixInsight's database, e.g. "Average Spiral Galaxy", "G2V Star"

name: run_spcc
